record_title: Optimal asymptotic tuning of the Hadamard construction for maximal equilateral sets
limitations: The optimality statement is restricted to the two-Hadamard construction of Swanepoel--Villa Proposition 23 and is not a lower bound for m(ell_p^d) itself. The result is asymptotic as p approaches 2. Literature searches found no exact or stronger coverage, but originality remains to the best of current knowledge.
